name: dexidp/dex
description: OpenID Connect identity and OAuth 2.0 provider with pluggable connectors for LDAP, SAML, GitHub, Google, and other identity backends, widely used in Kubernetes environments.
score_rationale: Well-established OIDC federation provider with 10.7k stars, Apache-2.0 licensed, actively maintained and commonly used as an identity broker in Kubernetes and cloud-native deployments.
